judgments.scenario: A new evidence identity uses the same effect_id as a settled effect but changes its complete conclusive fact
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The reservation becomes DISPUTED; no second committed contribution is added and conservative pending exposure is restored.

judgments.scenario: A contradictory NO_EFFECT record with null completion authorization arrives after the occurrence completed from a matching effect
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The record is retained and the prior route is not changed; a budget-backed occurrence also applies terminal-state reconciliation without granting release.

judgments.scenario: A same-fact duplicate NO_EFFECT record with null completion authorization arrives after an occurrence completed through authorized no-effect evidence
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No second completion or release occurs and the prior completed occurrence remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: Top-level shared_budgets omits an anchor used by one proposal-capable step
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: Two work-class steps use the same step identifier
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The duplicate semantic key is rejected before graph evaluation.

judgments.scenario: Profile LINEAR is paired with role DEADLINE_RUNTIME
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No instance state exists.

judgments.scenario: Dispatch connector binding digest differs from digest(connector-binding,{id,version})
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A closed graph can produce an occurrence with 65 enclosing context segments
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A matching dispatch on an active instance and occurrence has attempt SENT at the permit expiry instant, selects a retained clock at that same instant, and has acknowledgement NONE
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The permit is consumed, the occurrence becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and the dispatch is retained for effect reconciliation.

judgments.scenario: An initial authority-only proposal succeeds at clock T for a step with permit_seconds 300
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The permit expiry is exactly T plus 300 seconds, is exclusive and nonnull, and no budget transition is created.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only occurrence reproposes the exact request at the prior permit exclusive expiry with no consuming dispatch and current authority established
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Fresh authority is evaluated; the new finite permit supersedes the prior permit; proposal count advances; activation and actuation counts do not.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only occurrence attempts permit renewal before the prior permit exclusive expiry
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged; the earlier permit is not extended or superseded.

judgments.scenario: An expired undispatched occurrence proposes changed native request fields as a permit renewal
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged; no permit or reservation is changed.

judgments.scenario: A budget-backed occurrence renews its exact expired undispatched permit with current authority, complete current histories, and every affected budget still within bound
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exactly one embedded RENEW updates the same reservation once; the new permit supersedes the old one; no second exposure or actuation is created.

judgments.scenario: Current authority is revoked when renewing an expired undispatched permit
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The authority withholding is retained; the prior permit and reservation remain expired and unextended, the registry is unchanged, and the prior permit is not superseded.

judgments.scenario: A superseded permit is observed with NOT_SENT and no accepted acknowledgement
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The observation is retained; the expired superseded permit remains nondispatchable; the current permit and all budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A prior authority withholding has reached maximum_proposals and the next otherwise bound proposal also supplies invalid current authority
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The proposal-count ceiling precedes authority evaluation; work and budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: One RESERVE request affects two budgets whose settlement provider or source pairs differ
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The registry remains unchanged and no reservation is created.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only governed effect supplies a nonnull clock_revision despite carrying no budget input
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A governed effect provider differs from the exact completion-carrier provider
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged; no result field is interpreted.

judgments.scenario: A foreign established effect names a known reservation and supplies the exact retained anchor set and deterministic embedded SETTLE projection
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The registry returns EFFECT_DISPUTED and retains disputed exposure; work retains the FOREIGN outcome and exact receipt without completing an occurrence.

judgments.scenario: A foreign established effect names a stable unknown reservation and an exact nonempty history and anchor set
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The registry blocks each supplied projectable partition or policy-selected anchor fallback; work retains the foreign outcome and receipt.

judgments.scenario: A new evidence ID repeats the complete normalized fact of an earlier foreign effect
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: A foreign DUPLICATE outcome remains disputed, adds no exposure or completion, and retains the idempotent registry receipt.

judgments.scenario: A changed native request is observed with attempt REJECTED and no accepted acknowledgement
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The permit is consumed, the occurrence becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and the changed request is retained for reconciliation.

judgments.scenario: A branch operation establishes a failure whose declared failure behavior is STOP
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The triggering occurrence closes, its obligation becomes DISCHARGED without firing the join, and sibling obligations remain visible.

judgments.scenario: A first affirmative no-effect record arrives for an authority-only governed occurrence after it already expired
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The fact is retained with null lifecycle completion authorization; no completed row or route changes; any budget release still requires reservation administration.

judgments.scenario: Profile and role are admitted, but deployment authorization is unavailable
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No initial state is returned; the closed refusal retains the admitted profile and role.

judgments.scenario: A restart state contains two permits that both supersede the same prior permit for one occurrence
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The forked permit chain is rejected before the event is applied; supplied states remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A foreign effect names a known reservation but its wrapper affected anchors omit one retained contribution anchor
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and registry state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A successful renewal occurs after earlier withheld proposals but before maximum_proposals is reached
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The count advances by one decision receipt while maximum_actuations remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: An expired permit has only a NOT_SENT attempt with acknowledgement REJECTED before exact renewal
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The safe attempt does not block renewal; fresh authority is evaluated and the new permit supersedes the old one.

judgments.scenario: An expired permit has a prior SENT attempt before an attempted renewal
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged; no second permission is created.

judgments.scenario: A foreign effect branch carries NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN instead of EFFECT_ESTABLISHED
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: One clock event expires 64 object occurrences in separate fan-outs nested across a 64-branch parallel block, yielding a legal route-trace union of 65 construct identifiers
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The one ROUTE detail contains the sorted 65 construct identifiers and the complete atomic next state.

judgments.scenario: A proposal requires a shared budget whose settlement or no-effect provider/source differs from the active completion carrier
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and registry state remain unchanged; no permit or reservation is created.

judgments.scenario: A matching effect is observed after permit expiry for an unresolved occurrence whose exact request was dispatched before expiry
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The effect reconciles exposure, completes the occurrence and follows the normal declared route; permit expiry alone does not make the effect late.

judgments.scenario: After one conclusive governed effect, another established effect for the same permit and stable dispatch-attempt digest uses a distinct evidence_id and distinct provider-native operation identity
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The additional execution is retained and reconciled conservatively; it creates no second completion and never reroutes the occurrence.

judgments.scenario: A matching effect with a distinct evidence_id arrives after an authorized no-effect release for the same budget-backed provider-native operation identity, governed permit and stable dispatch-attempt digest
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The late effect and earlier no-effect outcomes name one another in symmetric conflict lists; disputed exposure is restored and routing remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A FANOUT_EXPAND success yields an empty set under empty_set_behavior STOP
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The retained pass has object_keys and obligation_ids empty and joined false; no object occurrence or join successor is created.

judgments.scenario: One clock due set includes an expiry stop and another closure whose successor deadline lacks an activation clock
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The DEADLINE detail names the sorted union of original due deadlines and the failing new deadline; no closure successor is created.

judgments.scenario: The final obligations of a nested parallel pass discharge and its join activates a successor
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The successor occurrence removes the joined BRANCH and region-local segments, retains the exact common outer prefix, and names every discharged final occurrence as predecessor.

judgments.scenario: An accepted correspondence record accounts for every declared source obligation and every exact work-class readback path and carries an accepted exact-subject review
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The result binds the work-class subject and complete correspondence evidence digest; it makes no semantic-fidelity claim.

judgments.scenario: A correspondence record omits one work-class readback path from both mappings and unsupported provisions
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No coverage acceptance is returned.

judgments.scenario: A basic accepted review record exactly matches the supplied external subject digest but its scope sufficiency is not supplied
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The result establishes accepted status and exact subject binding only; scope adequacy remains unclaimed.

judgments.scenario: Canonical bytes contain a closed accepted evidence record
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Every scalar leaf and empty collection in the evidence record appears in stable JSON-pointer order.

judgments.scenario: A structural step carries a positive nonnull permit_seconds
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The schema admits the field shape, but semantic validation rejects permit duration on a structural step. No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A proposal-capable completion carrier omits either its effect evidence triple or no-effect evidence triple
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED record uses the effect provider triple instead of the declared no-effect provider triple
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and registry state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: Retained lifecycle time establishes permit expiry, but the fresh renewal authority input has an unavailable current clock
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The withholding is retained; the prior permit and reservation remain unextended and unsuperseded.

judgments.scenario: One simultaneous due set stops during union preflight while due occurrences belong to parallel or fan-out obligations
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Every due occurrence closes and its enclosing obligation is discharged without firing a join; non-due siblings remain open or blocked.

judgments.scenario: A DISPATCH_OBSERVED event supplies null instead of an exact retained clock revision for permit-expiry evaluation
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged; no dispatch observation is retained.

judgments.scenario: A correspondence record lists one operative readback path both under a source-obligation mapping and in unsupported_provision_paths
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No correspondence acceptance is returned.

judgments.scenario: A correspondence subject pin differs while the top-level input and work-class pins equal the selected candidate
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No correspondence acceptance is returned.

judgments.scenario: The top-level correspondence input pin differs from the selected candidate manifest
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No evidence judgment is evaluated.

judgments.scenario: A restarted work state has a correctly recomputed outer state digest, but changes the retained deployment-authorization evidence while preserving its old internal evidence digest or authorization binding
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No event is evaluated and every supplied budget state remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: Current authority succeeds, but budget policy withholds renewal of an expired undispatched permit because the bound is violated
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The registry withholding receipt, next registry revision, one WITHHELD proposal record with the successful authority-result digest, registry receipt digest, null permit digest and exact prior-permit digest, and the work decision commit together. The prior permit and reservation remain expired, unextended and unsuperseded.

judgments.scenario: Exact success evidence follows the matching-argument dispatch in D2-168 that was observed at the permit expiry instant
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The effect is retained and exposure is reconciled conservatively, but the expired-dispatch occurrence does not route or complete successfully.

judgments.scenario: The readback property harness receives a generic canonical JSON value containing array positions 2 and 10, object keys containing slash and tilde, and non-ASCII keys
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The property output lines sort by complete escaped pointer bytes rather than numeric index or unescaped-token order, and each value string contains the canonical JSON serialization of its scalar or empty collection. This is a direct algorithm property, not an adapter readback request for an unrecognized artifact kind.

judgments.scenario: A DISPATCH_OBSERVED event selects a retained pre-expiry clock but asserts attempted_at at the later permit-expiry instant
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The future-relative attempt is not retained; work and budget states remain unchanged, so later governed effect evidence has no dispatch binding.

judgments.scenario: A dispatch acknowledgement has status ACCEPTED but null reference and observation time
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No dispatch observation is retained; work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A matching SENT dispatch is reported after permit expiry, but its exact attempted_at is before expiry and no supersession or closure applies; exact matching effect evidence follows
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The late dispatch report retains the timely attempt without PERMIT_EXPIRED; later exact evidence may settle exposure and advance the work graph.

judgments.scenario: A DISPATCH_OBSERVED event asserts attempted_at before the retained clock that issued its permit
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The backdated attempt is not retained; work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: The request supplies an admitted LINEAR and LINEAR_WORK_RUNTIME pair, but the exact work-class definition declares CHOICE_LOOPS
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No initial state is created and the definition is not interpreted under the lower profile.

judgments.scenario: The request supplies an admitted profile-role pair that differs from the supplied definition profile or retained state pair
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A correspondence input profile differs from the exact supplied work-class profile while its profile value is otherwise admitted
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No correspondence acceptance is returned.

judgments.scenario: A governed EFFECT_ESTABLISHED record claims an event_time before its retained dispatch attempt
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The claimed effect is retained, completion_mismatch is true for conservative reconciliation, and the occurrence does not route.

judgments.scenario: A governed EFFECT_ESTABLISHED record claims event_time after its own observed_at
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The temporally contradictory effect is retained and blocks unsafe progression; it cannot complete the occurrence.

judgments.scenario: A budget-backed effect observation has observed_at later than the selected latest retained registry clock
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Work and registry state remain unchanged; the host must retain the raw evidence and may resubmit after admitting a current clock.

judgments.scenario: A schema-valid foreign established effect claims event_time after observed_at
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The record remains attributable and disputed; the embedded observed_request is null, completion_mismatch is true, the anchor fallback applies, and the claimed future event time cannot free capacity.

judgments.scenario: A first affirmative no-effect record with a distinct evidence_id and distinct provider-native operation identity arrives for an already successfully completed authority-only occurrence and binds to the same governed permit and stable dispatch-attempt digest as the earlier effect
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The no-effect record and symmetric conflict identities are retained with no completion authorization. The completed row, route, and terminal instance status remain unchanged, but dependent work is blocked because one governed invocation cannot both have and not have an effect.

judgments.scenario: A governed established effect matches the permit and completion carrier, but the shared-budget journal does not corroborate the committed event required for settlement
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The registry retains disputed exposure; the lifecycle changes the occurrence to BLOCKED_DISPUTE and does not apply the otherwise matching success route.

judgments.scenario: A nonnull deployment-authorization expiry equals or precedes the exact authorization-clock instant
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No initial work state is created.

judgments.scenario: A governed UNKNOWN outcome is otherwise exact, but its shared-budget registry is already disputed and returns EFFECT_DISPUTED
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The occurrence remains unresolved, the existing disputed exposure remains charged, and no route is selected.

judgments.scenario: A descendant was dispatched before its completed ancestor became disputed; exact matching effect evidence later arrives while the descendant occurrence is BLOCKED_DISPUTE, with no shared budget or with an exact required SETTLED budget receipt
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Any required settlement commits and the conclusive result is retained, but the exact descendant remains BLOCKED_DISPUTE and its directly owning obligation, if any, remains BLOCKED while the ancestor dispute is unresolved; no route, join or successor is created.

judgments.scenario: After a governed budget-backed effect settled, a second conclusive record with a distinct evidence_id for the same provider-native operation changes lifecycle evidence content such as record_digest while leaving the narrower reservation-native projection otherwise equal
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The lifecycle forces completion_mismatch true in the embedded settlement, the registry retains disputed exposure instead of treating it as a harmless duplicate, the earlier completed row and route remain unchanged, and dependent active descendants are blocked.

judgments.scenario: A governed budget-backed effect is otherwise LATE_MATCHED after deadline closure, but its supplied journal does not corroborate the settlement and the registry returns EFFECT_DISPUTED
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The expired occurrence and route remain unchanged; the registry retains disputed exposure and the work state retains the late evidence without routing.

judgments.scenario: A previously permitted descendant becomes BLOCKED_DISPUTE after an ancestor conflict, then a matching SENT native attempt with acknowledgement status NONE and an otherwise valid timeline is reported against that retained permit
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The possibly-sent attempt consumes the permit and is retained for reconciliation, but the occurrence remains BLOCKED_DISPUTE, its directly owning obligation, if any, remains BLOCKED, and dispatchability is not restored.

judgments.scenario: An available CLOCK event satisfies an AT_OR_AFTER pending deadline whose occurrence and enclosing obligation are already dependency-blocked
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The deadline becomes EXPIRED as evidence, while the occurrence remains BLOCKED_DISPUTE and its directly owning obligation, if any, remains BLOCKED; no expiry route, join, successor or terminal-status change occurs.

judgments.scenario: Two retained governed conclusive facts for one provider-native operation already conflict; a new distinct evidence_id repeats exactly the first fact
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The duplicate adds no completion or exposure, inherits disputed true and the other fact group as its conflict set, and every outcome in the other fact group adds the duplicate evidence identity to its symmetric sorted conflict set.

judgments.scenario: An eligible AT_OR_AFTER deadline expires and its declared EXPIRY relationship enters a PARALLEL_SPLIT with two branch heads within all limits
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The expired predecessor moves to completed; the clock event atomically creates the parallel pass, both branch obligations and both active branch occurrences. Each obligation names the expired predecessor in source_occurrence_ids and the exact CLOCK event digest as creation_event_digest.

judgments.scenario: A schema-valid foreign EFFECT_OBSERVED resolves to a step with a nonempty shared_budgets set, but supplies null reservation identity, no affected anchors, and no registry input
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The event cannot convert a budget-bearing operation into an authority-only foreign effect. Work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: An OUTCOME_UNKNOWN assertion is attributed to a dispatch request that differed from the committed permit for a budget-backed occurrence
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The native fact is retained, the reservation becomes or remains DISPUTED, unresolved pending exposure remains charged, the affected anchors are blocked, and the occurrence does not route or complete.

judgments.scenario: A NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED assertion is attributed to a dispatch request that differed from the committed permit for a budget-backed occurrence
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The no-effect fact is retained as UNEXPECTED with null completion authorization. The reservation becomes or remains DISPUTED, unresolved pending exposure remains charged, the affected anchors are blocked, and no release, completion, or route occurs.

judgments.scenario: A matching success effect for an eligible directly owned occurrence enters a nested parallel split with two valid branch heads and all structural limits available
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The direct parent obligation becomes WAITING on the exact child-pass reference while both child obligations and active occurrences are created atomically. Any outer ancestor obligation remains waiting on the parent pass.

judgments.scenario: A matching success effect discharges the final child obligation of a nested pass, and the child join closure activates one proposal-capable successor in the parent region
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: All child obligations become JOINED; the directly waiting parent obligation becomes OPEN and names the new parent-region occurrence. The new occurrence predecessor list equals the recursive child completion frontier.

judgments.scenario: A matching success effect discharges the final child obligation of a nested pass, and the child join closure immediately reaches the join of its parent obligation
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The child obligations become JOINED and the parent obligation becomes DISCHARGED with a CHILD_PASS completion basis. If that discharge completes another eligible pass, fixed-point joining continues in the same transition.

judgments.scenario: A directly owned child operation enters a policy stop before its nested child obligation inventory can be created
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No child pass or child obligation is created. The directly owning obligation becomes DISCHARGED with the triggering DIRECT_EVENT basis, no join fires, and every outer waiting ancestor remains WAITING in the stopped instance.

judgments.scenario: A fresh process receives a valid ACTIVE checkpoint whose parent obligation is WAITING on an exact existing incomplete child pass, then receives a proposal for one OPEN child occurrence with current accepted authority and no shared budget
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Restart admits the closed waiting variant because the child-pass identity, outer prefix, obligation inventory, and acyclic nesting all agree. The subsequent child proposal creates one permit and preserves the parent WAITING reference.

judgments.scenario: One branch obligation is DISCHARGED, its sibling remains OPEN, and later conflicting conclusive evidence disputes the completed occurrence in the discharged branch
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The completed row and route remain historical, the unjoined DISCHARGED obligation becomes DISPUTED while retaining its completion basis, and the pass cannot join after the sibling later discharges.

judgments.scenario: A nested child pass contains an obligation that becomes DISPUTED before its parent pass has joined
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The direct child obligation is DISPUTED. Its WAITING parent becomes the waiting form of DISPUTED with the exact child-pass reference, and the condition propagates through every waiting ancestor. No affected pass is join-eligible.

judgments.scenario: A one-object fan-out is in a STOPPED instance, and a matching effect reaches its still-active non-BLOCKED_DISPUTE object occurrence with no shared budget or with an exact SETTLED budget receipt
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The pass remains all-DISCHARGED and not JOINED. Restart admits this otherwise complete pass only because the retained stop decision and direct completion basis prove that stopped-instance rules suppressed the join.

judgments.scenario: An ACTIVE checkpoint contains a pass whose complete obligation inventory is DISCHARGED but not JOINED
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The state is rejected because the eligible join should have fired atomically in the transition that discharged the final obligation.

judgments.scenario: A proposal names a valid frozen fan-out occurrence for object A but its declared object-request field contains object B
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The occurrence-to-object check fails before authority or reservation evaluation. Work and every supplied budget state remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A proposal inside nested fan-outs supplies distinct declared request fields whose typed values equal the retained outer and inner object keys, has current accepted authority, and requires no shared budget
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Both occurrence-to-object bindings succeed, authority succeeds, no reservation input is required, and the proposal creates one permit under the ordinary atomic proposal rule.

judgments.scenario: Two nested fan-out definitions use the same object-request field name on one descendant path
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The definition is rejected because one native request field cannot carry two independently bound enclosing object identities. No instance is created.

judgments.scenario: One available CLOCK event supplies a due set that directly discharges the last obligations of several independent and nested passes; every continuing closure is within limits and has no expiry stop, missing activation clock, immediately due deadline, time overflow, or other stop condition
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The consumer applies direct discharges, joins eligible passes from greater depth outward in canonical child-pass order, and commits the complete fixed-point successor state atomically.

judgments.scenario: In one unjoined branch, operation A completed and routed to B, B completed and discharged the branch obligation, and later conflicting evidence disputes A while a sibling obligation remains open
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The dependency-affected set contains A and completed descendant B. Because the discharged obligation completion frontier contains B, that obligation becomes DISPUTED and the pass can never join in this candidate. Restart recomputes the same intersection and admits the resulting disputed-completion variant.

judgments.scenario: A timely matching SENT attempt was retained with acknowledgement NONE and changed the occurrence to DISPATCHED; a later event reuses the byte-identical attempt and supplies a timely ACCEPTED acknowledgement
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The consumer records the acknowledgement update without invoking the connector, adds no LATE_OR_PROHIBITED_DISPATCH reason, and leaves the occurrence DISPATCHED.

judgments.scenario: After restart and after the occurrence completed from effect evidence, a later event reuses its earlier timely matching SENT attempt whose acknowledgement was NONE and supplies the first timely ACCEPTED acknowledgement
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The consumer records the late acknowledgement as an update to the original attempt using its original permission facts. It does not invoke the connector, add LATE_OR_PROHIBITED_DISPATCH, recreate the occurrence, or change the completed route or terminal instance status.

judgments.scenario: A proposal-capable step omits the required permit_seconds field
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The closed step schema rejects the missing required property before semantic definition checks. No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A proposal-capable step supplies permit_seconds as zero
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The closed step schema rejects zero because a permit duration is a canonical positive integer. No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only occurrence completed from conclusive effect evidence bound to a SENT/NONE dispatch record; a later acknowledgement update retains the same permit and dispatch-attempt digest under a new complete dispatch digest, and a no-effect record with a distinct evidence_id and different provider-native operation identity binds to that updated dispatch
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Both conclusive outcomes become disputed with symmetric conflict evidence identities because they concern the same permit and stable native attempt. The completed route remains unchanged, no capacity is released, and the later acknowledgement observation remains separately attributable.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only occurrence closed from authorized no-effect evidence bound to a SENT/NONE dispatch record; a later acknowledgement update retains the same permit and dispatch-attempt digest under a new complete dispatch digest, and established effect evidence with a distinct evidence_id and different provider-native operation identity binds to that updated dispatch
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Both conclusive outcomes become disputed with symmetric conflict evidence identities because they concern the same permit and stable native attempt. The earlier no-effect closure is not erased, the graph is not rerouted, and the late effect is retained.

judgments.scenario: A budget-backed governed effect duplicates a retained same-fact CONFLICTING outcome under a new evidence identity and reference
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The lifecycle copies the retained embedded reservation-native fact except for the new evidence identity and reference, including completion_mismatch:true. The reservation transition returns the established disputed disposition without adding exposure or creating a different conflict; the completed route and blocked dependencies remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: The reference host receives a byte-identical successful deploy request and calculated initial state for an organization and instance whose authoritative initial root was already installed from those exact bytes
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The host returns the established authoritative state digest with replay:true, creates no second root, changes no state, and performs no dispatch.

judgments.scenario: The reference host receives a different successful deploy request and calculated initial state for an occupied organization-and-instance namespace
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The response binds the authoritative and proposed state digests, returns replay:false and dispatch_performed:false, and leaves the one authoritative root unchanged.

judgments.scenario: An authority-only work class with no deadline deploys with an empty initial_clocks array; a first available CLOCK event introduces the host-selected authority source at a canonical natural revision, then a proposal selects that retained clock and supplies current accepted authority with no shared budget
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The first clock establishes the source baseline. The subsequent proposal uses that exact source and revision, appends one PERMITTED proposal record and permit, and requires no registry input.

judgments.scenario: An initial proposal has current accepted authority, the work class has exhausted maximum_actuations, and the otherwise shape-valid required registry input also carries a stale expected revision
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The actuation ceiling is evaluated before the cloned reservation transition. The work state retains the successful authority basis and stop receipt, creates no proposal record, permit or reservation, and leaves the supplied registry state unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A first CLOCK event introduces source S at revision 5 with status UNAVAILABLE; a new AVAILABLE event for S reuses revision 5; after that refusal, another AVAILABLE event for S uses revision 6 and a valid baseline time
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The unavailable record advances only the revision watermark. The equal-revision available sample leaves state unchanged. The greater revision is accepted as the source's first available time baseline, leaving one uniquely keyed row per retained clock record.

judgments.scenario: A first NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED assertion is attributed to a changed-argument dispatch that may have reached the connector for an authority-only occurrence
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The no-effect fact is retained with null completion authorization. The unresolved occurrence remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and no completion, route, or release is inferred from the disqualified dispatch.

judgments.scenario: A budget-backed permit has attempt A recorded as NOT_SENT with no accepted acknowledgement, followed by attempt B recorded as SENT; a first NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED assertion with valid completion authorization binds attempt A
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Attempt A is not the last distinct attempt. The no-effect fact is retained with completion_mismatch true, attempt B remains possibly effective, the reservation becomes or remains DISPUTED, pending exposure remains charged, and no completion, route, or release occurs.

judgments.scenario: A budget-backed permit has attempt A recorded as NOT_SENT with no accepted acknowledgement, followed by attempt B recorded as SENT; a first NO_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED assertion with valid completion authorization and release administration binds attempt B
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Attempt B is the last distinct attempt and every other attempt is definitively safe. The reservation is released once, the occurrence completes as NO_EFFECT, and its declared failure edge is followed.

judgments.scenario: A structurally admitted aggregate-step request is sent to a consumer whose capability claim omits SHARED_BUDGET_TRANSITIONS
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No reservation transition runs. The protocol-level closed refusal is returned without claiming or changing a reservation state.

judgments.scenario: A proposal-capable step omits prior_effect_bindings or prior_actor_separations
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A prior-effect binding names a source evidence field absent from the source completion carrier
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A prior-effect binding connects source and target fields with different nominal type references
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A structural step declares a nonempty prior-effect or prior-actor array
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No runtime state exists.

judgments.scenario: A current proposal requires a prior effect but no qualifying completed ancestor exists
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged; current authority is not evaluated.

judgments.scenario: Two qualifying completed ancestors match one UNIQUE_COMPLETED_ANCESTOR prior-effect binding
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged; no recency, ordinal, or distance tie-break is applied.

judgments.scenario: The unique completed ancestor established destination_account A while the current payment proposal requests destination_account B
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged; authority and reservation are not evaluated.

judgments.scenario: The unique completed ancestor supplies every declared prior-effect field with the same nominal type and canonical value as the current proposal
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The permit retains one exact prior-effect basis per declared binding; any required reservation commits atomically with the work state.

judgments.scenario: A matching completed effect exists only in another instance, sibling path, or non-predecessor history
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged.

judgments.scenario: The prior selected VERIFY actor and current selected INSTANCE_DECISION actor have distinct exact identifiers
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The permit retains the complete current authority-act projection and one satisfied separation basis; any required reservation commits atomically.

judgments.scenario: One actor performs the selected prior VERIFY and current INSTANCE_DECISION under different roles and capacities
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The decision retains the exact separation comparison basis; no permit or reservation is created and budgets remain unchanged.

judgments.scenario: The prior step completed successfully but its establishing permit contains no selected authority act of the declared prior_act_kind
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A restarted state retains a current or prior permit containing more than one authority-act basis of the separation requirement's declared act kind
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Exact supplied work and budget states returned unchanged; restart integrity rejects the retained permit before evaluating the new event.

judgments.scenario: Current authority is withheld and the supplied actor identifiers would also violate a declared prior-actor separation
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The authority withholding takes precedence; no separation decision, permit, or reservation is created.

judgments.scenario: Actor separation is violated and a supplied required budget input also has a stale revision
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The separation withholding takes precedence; the budget transition is not evaluated and the budget remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A restarted state contains unchanged prior-effect, authority-act, and satisfied-separation permit bases, then receives a greater-revision available clock event with no deadline due
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The next event is evaluated without process-local history. The clock is retained, the state advances once, and every retained permit basis and budget state remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: A restarted state omits a required prior-effect, authority-act, or satisfied-separation permit basis, or changes a complete selected act without updating its retained digest commitments
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No new event is evaluated and supplied budget state remains unchanged.

judgments.scenario: Later conclusive evidence disputes the source effect used by a retained descendant permit
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The original permit basis remains retained; LIFE-013 blocks affected active descendants and does not rewrite earlier permission or completed routing.

judgments.scenario: An exact proposal with prior-effect and separation bases is replayed after restart
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The original permit and bases are returned with the current state; no state or reservation revision changes.

judgments.scenario: Two syntactically distinct actor identifiers satisfy DISTINCT_ACTOR in the semantic consumer
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Mechanical comparison succeeds, but deployment assurance still requires the host to authenticate that the identifiers name different real actors.

judgments.scenario: Two prior-actor separations are declared; the first by identifier compares equal actors and a later requirement also lacks a selected act
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The decision retains only the first failing comparison basis; later separation requirements and the budget transition are not evaluated.

judgments.scenario: A reservation native record supplies completion_mismatch false with a nonnull mismatch_reason, or completion_mismatch true with a null reason
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: The exact prior registry state is returned unchanged; no evidence or receipt is retained.

judgments.scenario: A restarted separation-withholding decision changes the complete current authority act while retaining its prior act digest or authority-result commitment
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: No new event is evaluated and supplied budget state remains unchanged.

judgments.expected_judgment: EFFECT_DISPUTED with NATIVE_REQUEST_MISMATCH or UNEXPECTED_EFFECT respectively
judgments.scenario: Two completion-mismatched NO_EFFECT records differ only in their declared supported cause: changed or disqualified dispatch versus another unexpected or conflicting lifecycle conclusion
judgments.state_and_budget_consequence: Both retain disputed exposure and block the affected anchor; each receipt copies its exact closed mismatch reason rather than inferring a cause from the Boolean.

method: Each expected judgment was derived from the cited draft-2 normative rule and scenario before either draft-2 implementation was run. These lifecycle and contract-delta judgments supplement the independently frozen draft-1 authority, aggregate, reservation, canonicalization, readback, and evidence cases; they do not replace those core cases. Exact fixture bytes and complete outputs are produced and reviewed before suite freeze.
